provenance.sourceImport: Pinned upstream f43dd94 plus deliberate local P3 context-bound Gateway, strict ingress, ordered observer and official Stage registration patches, and local P5 bounded native DAVE voice cutover. NOT unmodified upstream or a claimed upstream release. Independent module/example manifest edits are outside this SDK-package census.
provenance.catalogKind: Reviewed source inventory only; not protobuf/converter/runtime verification
provenance.sdkCommitScope: sdkCommit/sdkVersion/sdkUpstreamTree identify the pinned upstream base only, not the patched local source tree.

localSourcePatches.P3: Context-aware shared Gateway lifecycle/writers; bounded ingress and callback join; ordered raw host observer and detached Before snapshots; uppercase STAGE_INSTANCE_* registration; corrected API/voice endpoint initialization. Parent-approved Go1.27 vet correction uses a literal %s format for ErrUnauthorized informational logging in RequestWithLockedBucket; no module API/behavior change. Parent-assigned Message.UnmarshalJSON partial-components correction preserves omitted nil versus present empty slice, avoiding implicit cache component deletion on partial MESSAGE_UPDATE.
localSourcePatches.P5: Bounded context-native voice API/engine with DAVE under voice+cgo; ordinary unsupported backend; private credential dispatch and immutable Opus handoff; removed legacy ChannelVoiceJoin/speaking/channel/UDP paths. Parent-assigned crypto review separates reset/proposal/prepared-ID deadlines and binds pending-reset authorization to authenticated opcode24 epoch1 plus current generation/version/successful opcode26 write; deferred opcode25 may complete matching unconsumed authorization. Native crypto ABI/patch remains unchanged.

provenance.canonicalModule: github.com/chatanium/discordgo; version and checksum come from the consuming Go module, not the historical upstream sdkVersion field
provenance.canonicalImportReview: voice_gateway.go and voice_transport.go import the canonical module's internal/dave package. These import-only changes update the active source hashes; upstream-base identity and historical baseline/audit records are unchanged. discordgo/ source identities are stable inventory labels, not local checkout paths.
provenance.publicationSourceReview: Published v0.30.0 incorporates gofmt doc-comment layout changes in logging.go and oauth2.go; the five reviewed Application method documentation fingerprints follow those comments without changing signatures, bodies, defaults or classifications. voice.go's active fingerprint corrects an already stale pin to the byte-identical source in main commit 3158838b78dd92cb8220673cc4887d009204ef1a. Historical snapshots and audits remain unchanged.
provenance.retirementSourceReview: The published voice.go matches existing main source but active inventories lagged its retirement handshake. VoiceConnection.leaveAck and leaveConfirmed are private runtime-only state: ordered null-channel observation closes the acknowledgement; DisconnectContext waits within CloseTimeout, joins confirmation errors, and retains the reservation until cleanup and confirmation. Two extra anonymous empty struct channel types are implementation-local. Other nested identity changes and public declaration fingerprints are source-position shifts plus the separately reviewed OAuth documentation formatting; no module exposure changes.
provenance.sourceFormatting: Parent-applied final SDK formatting incorporated into exact frozen source byte hashes. Pinned upstream f43dd94 plus reviewed local P3/P5 corrections; no semantic reformatting or SDK edits performed by the inventory owner.

fieldBoundaryPolicies.reason: io.Reader는 런타임 핸들입니다. 별도 core upload가 완료된 뒤 참조를 사용하고 런타임은 lease와 재개방 가능한 spool reader를 획득합니다.
operator-provisioned 사용자 guilds.join 자격증명을 인스턴스/app/user/guild/만료에 묶고 런타임만 해석합니다.
raw token 또는 token처럼 위장한 ref 문자열을 SDK Token에 넣지 않습니다.
반환 payload, URL, 오류에서 원문 토큰을 제거합니다. interaction ref의 용도를 일반 webhook 권한으로 확장하지 않습니다.
인증정보가 도메인 User DTO로 새지 않게 제거합니다. 봇 토큰 또는 토큰 발급 기능을 모듈에 제공하지 않습니다.
세션/voice 연결 식별 정보는 P5 백엔드 내부 상태이며 raw session resume 또는 voice transport를 모듈로 넘기지 않습니다.

SDK Activity.Secrets는 runtime bot token과 동일시하지 않습니다. 앱이 정의한 activity join/match/spectate 도메인 값은 필드 단위 정책으로 변환하되 runtime 인증정보가 채워질 수 있는 경로는 boundary encoder에서 참조화/제거합니다. 비밀을 무조건 일반 string dump로 취급하지 않습니다.
